history.description: Use when an approved "[devflow] Brief" epic, with its context gathered, needs breaking into cards, or when a person asks to plan, slice or break an epic into tasks on the devpit board.

notes: One run per configuration per case; iterations 1 to 3 are in history and the skill beat the baseline on every case in each.
`plan` is a mock shaped as this skill describes it (preview unless apply is true); card [devflow] 05 implements the real tool.

The baseline finds the prefactor and the expand-contract shape on its own when the context points at them; it loses by calling apply: true on its first call in every iteration, creating cards nobody approved, and by verifying behaviour cards with the whole suite.
Iteration 1 led to one change in the skill: a card that adds behaviour verifies with its own tests, while a prefactor, docs or contract card runs the whole suite.

The verify and contract checks were corrected after reading transcripts (they first knew only a few title words for prefactor, docs, tests-only and contract cards); every saved run of every iteration was graded again with the final code.

Trigger run 1 false-triggered on 'Implement the first card of the due dates plan'; the description now says an existing card belongs to the execution stage, and run 2 had no false trigger. One should-trigger miss remains: 'the epic is ready. what are the tasks and which ones block which?'.
